mechanism: Both drugs are hepatically metabolized and can elevate uric acid levels; levofloxacin may increase pyrazinamide concentrations through hepatic competition, while pyrazinamide-induced hyperuricemia is enhanced, increasing gout risk.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels, renal function, and liver function tests; use with caution in patients with gout history or renal impairment; consider alternative fluoroquinolone if hyperuricemia develops.
